item.title: Prostitute Sign To Mute, Share “Mr. Dada” Video
item.description: We named Dearborn, MI marauders Prostitute a Band To Watch early this year on the strength of their 2024 debut album Attempted Martyr, which channels their experience as Arab Americans into incendiary Midwestern noise-rock. You know who else was watching these guys? Mute Records. The legendary British record label has signed Prostitute and will give Attempted Martyr its first global release in March.
